summary: Strict read-only recheck completed on public preview URL. Health, password login, auth/me, and representative read endpoints all work (200, no 500). Cross-origin credentialed auth CORS contract still fails at edge (ACAO='*', missing ACAC), matching prior incident symptoms for frontend no-data after redirect.

critical.issue: Credentialed cross-origin contract still broken: response returns Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' and omits Access-Control-Allow-Credentials on preview edge probe.

minor.issue: Direct runtime inspection of backend process env key type from this test shell was not available; local backend/.env key type classifies as LEGACY_JWT_SERVICE_ROLE.

integration_issues.flow: Cross-origin login session propagation to data pages
integration_issues.issue: If frontend is on different origin, wildcard ACAO + missing ACAC can block credentialed cookie flow and lead to apparent post-login no-data state.

action_items: Fix edge/proxy CORS behavior for /api/auth/* to echo explicit allowed origin and include Access-Control-Allow-Credentials=true for credentialed requests.
Validate effective deployed env key type in running backend process (sanitized classification only) to confirm whether NEW_SB_SECRET is actually active after redeploy.
Re-test cross-origin browser flow after CORS correction using same preview URL and credentials.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py defines credentialed CORS enforcement, but observed public response headers indicate edge/proxy is overriding or stripping contract-critical headers.
No evidence in inspected auth/supabase files of jwt.decode being applied to SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY; auth_jwt decoding is scoped to JWT_SECRET app tokens.
SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY_1 secondary-read path exists in routes_finance; no hardcoded service-role literal found in inspected runtime files.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (2/2 targeted checks: login page load and password login redirect)

context_for_next_testing_agent: This run was strict diagnostics only with no business data mutation. Password login مدير/010101 succeeded via API and UI. Read-only endpoints users/vehicles/customers/accounts/finance journal returned 200. CORS probe still fails on preview edge (ACAO='*', ACAC missing). Local backend/.env Supabase key type classifies as LEGACY_JWT_SERVICE_ROLE; effective remote process key type could not be directly introspected from this shell.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: POST /api/auth/login with Origin=https://accounting-ssot-fix.preview.emergentagent.com and valid مدير/010101. Result: 200 with cookies set, but headers show Access-Control-Allow-Origin='*' and no Access-Control-Allow-Credentials. Backend code intends credentialed CORS (allow_credentials=True and explicit origin rewrite), so first failure point category is CORS/EDGE-CONTRACT, not PASSWORD_VERIFY or USER_LOOKUP. This explains frontend symptom 'login works but data not appearing' in cross-origin contexts because cookie-backed auth/session cannot be used reliably by browser policy. JWT_SECRET_CHANGE_REQUIRED=NO based on successful token issuance/verification paths and absence of JWT decode failures in this scope.
